decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR gives the subject the release note leaves out. [ev-36485c3733df] says the change adds a custom action to enable and disable the full-promote feature for Numaplane rollouts during a Progressive upgrade. [ev-f2346ea67f7f] lists the files added: built-in resource actions `enable-force-promote` and `disable-force-promote` (Lua scripts plus `discovery.lua`) under `resource_customizations/numaplane.numaproj.io/ISBServiceRollout`, with 14 more files not shown that are presumably other Numaplane rollout kinds. So the subject is the new built-in resource actions for the `numaplane.numaproj.io` rollout kinds, the change type is added, and only environments managing those resources can use the actions. This is an optional action that someone has to run, so nothing happens to an operator who does nothing. One gap: the full list of rollout kinds is cut off.
